plan.title: SRC-SCH-019 Fixed Technical End with RFQ Duration

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
Apply a template to the Technical stage.
Add the required project line item.

args.goal: On the Technical stage, set the schedule End time mode to Fixed time with a valid fixed end time, save the schedule, and stop when the Technical schedule summary shows the fixed end time

steps.note: Set and commit the Technical stage's fixed end-time schedule, which has no dedicated catalog schedule argument.
Apply a pricing template to the RFQ stage.
Fill any remaining mandatory fields across the configured stages.
Set and commit the RFQ stage to a 60-minute duration.
Add a QA vendor so the publish precondition is otherwise satisfied.
